implementation: Existing replyCycleEvidence no longer builds Object.values/filter/sort action arrays; single pass selects latest matching receipt using numeric timestamps; rejects after10000own actions before mailbox check, rather than claiming an incomplete result. Equal timestamps keep last encountered receipt.

Latest local and remote evidence uses bounded ID/date/text projection (998byte IDs,256KiB UTF8 text); remote arbitrary extra fields are not spread into response. Oversized latest proof never falls back to older receipt. Missing/malformed team result raises reply_evidence_incomplete503 even with local receipt.

Original input text must be a string <=2MiB UTF8 before existing18000character display slice; display truncation remains explicit. Accepted lists<=100, recipient strings<=998bytes. Source/actions remain unchanged; no new route/storage/worker.

New tests invoke real module with synthetic originals/actions/team results; existing full local HTTP/SQLite/store suite passes. No new full HTTP/provider test claimed.
